landscape.title: Pipeline demo: binary search
landscape.description: A demo of the daily video pipeline.

scenes.title: Binary search
scenes.narration: Checking a million sorted numbers one by one takes a million checks. A million numbers, twenty checks. Here's the trick.

scenes.title: Step by step
scenes.narration: We want twenty three. First, look at the middle. Sixteen is too small, so throw away the left and keep the right half. One check removed half the list.

scenes.title: Your turn
scenes.narration: Halve the search every time. Now solve it yourself on CodeKairo.
